## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Mellum2 12B-A2.5B Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~8.2 GB, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-GGUF/tree/978d3b633817824470ef48a53141e3dccf1863f0))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf bartowski/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf bartowski/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~12.9 GB) `llama cli -hf bartowski/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-GGUF:Q8_0`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Mellum2 12B-A2.5B Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~8.2 GB, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-GGUF/tree/978d3b633817824470ef48a53141e3dccf1863f0))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: Q8_0 (~12.9 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-GGUF@Q8_0 -y` · 4bit (~6.8 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-4bit -y` · 8bit (~12.9 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-8bit -y`

### Ollama

1. Install Ollama. [Download it (macOS / Windows)](https://ollama.com/download)
   
   ```sh
   # Linux
   curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh
   ```

2. Run Mellum2 12B-A2.5B Instruct (Q4_K_M, needs ~8.2 GB, from [huggingface.co/bartowski](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-GGUF/tree/978d3b633817824470ef48a53141e3dccf1863f0))
   
   ```sh
   ollama run hf.co/bartowski/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-GGUF:Q4_K_M
   ```

Other versions: Q8_0 (~12.9 GB) `ollama run hf.co/bartowski/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-GGUF:Q8_0`

### MLX (Mac)

1. Install MLX (Mac). Apple silicon Macs only, text only.
   
   ```sh
   # with uv
   uv tool install mlx-lm
   # or
   pip install mlx-lm
   ```

2. Run Mellum2 12B-A2.5B Instruct (4bit, needs ~6.8 GB, Mac only, from [huggingface.co/mlx-community](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-4bit/tree/714f4fdf47a46832e41cc80f446eb56541666ee9))
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-4bit
   ```

3. Or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-4bit
   ```

Other versions: 8bit (~12.9 GB, Mac only) `mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct-8bit`

### Other ways to run it

1. Run it as published (BF16, needs ~24.3 GB, NVIDIA only, from [huggingface.co/JetBrains](https://huggingface.co/JetBrains/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct/tree/273d9c1c6882ac8e1562e5b7e043857d35a787b6))
   
   ```sh
   vllm serve JetBrains/Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct
   ```
